source_title: Ayari on target as Brighton stun Manchester City to close gap on leaders
source_excerpt:
Manchester City have lost two consecutive league games, but no alarm should be sounded. Enzo Maresca’s fast-passing team were defeated on Saturday because Yasin Ayari took one of Brighton’s rare chances, the 11th-minute winner deriving from what appeared a wrongly awarded free-kick for Elliot Anderson’s foul on Ayari.
Brighton can be proud of victory here – and of being third. They are worth the lofty position and who would bet against Champions League qualification? They protected their lead admirably because City kept coming at them: City’s problem was the final touch or finish and not creating enough for the lethal Erling Haaland.
When Nico O’Reilly, a second-half substitute, zipped the ball across goal towards the end, Iliman Ndiaye sprayed wide – a fair summation of what cost City.
Ndiaye and Josko Gvardiol were replaced after this by Phil Foden and Allan Elias as Maresca tried to salvage a point or better. It did not occur, but his stewardship continues to impress, three months in.
City were slick throughout, as when Ayyoub Bouaddi’s quick feet found Enzo Fernández and he poked the ball out to the left with a no-look pass that found the menacing Jérémy Doku.
But they were made to look chumps when Ayari scored despite the move emanating from the free-kick given against Anderson. Maresca said he had not seen the incident back.
Lewis Dunk swept the dead ball right to Diego Gómez and from this point City slumbered. When Gómez crossed, Matheus Nunes missed his clearance, the ball came back in via Maxim De Cuyper, and Ayari scored into an empty goal, with Gianluigi Donnarumma stranded.
As in City’s Carabao Cup penalty shootout win over Brighton here on Wednesday, the visitors pummelled the hosts – for a period. City required a spark, so Anderson stepped up, his snake-hips along the right creating space for a pinpoint ball that Ndiaye should have headed home, not wide.
The Senegal international next wowed with a throwback slaloming run that took him from the right and near halfway into Brighton’s area. Suddenly, the target gaped and if he had driven beyond Bart Verbruggen and not into the goalkeeper’s gloves it would have been a goal of the season contender.
It was the centrepiece of a swashbuckling response from City, as a Doku raid wreaked havoc along Brighton’s right and Haaland, Gvardiol and Fernández all might have scored an equaliser.
• Brighton have beaten Manchester City away from home in any competition for the very first time, at the 18th attempt (D5 L12).
• Manchester City have failed to score at home in the Premier League for the first time in 23 games, since a 2-0 defeat to Spurs in August 2025.
• Brighton have won five of their last six Premier League matches, keeping a clean sheet in all five victories, indeed they have the most clean sheets (6) in the competition this season.
• Manchester City have lost consecutive Premier League games for the first time since August 2025, which included a 2-1 victory for Brighton.
• Manchester City had 21 shots against Brighton, their most attempts without scoring in a Premier League home game since November 2024 (23 against Spurs).
• This was the first Saturday 3pm Premier League game between two sides in the top three since October 2019, when Liverpool, as leaders, beat third-place Leicester 2-1 at Anfield. Opta
If this thrust and cut recalled Pep Guardiola’s finer City vintages, there was an added element of the pace that is Maresca’s particular special sauce. A 50-yard diagonal speared from Anderson to the galloping Doku was another moment of high quality. As half-time neared, Haaland was the recipient after more of Anderson’s scheming; the Norwegian adjusted his feet and unloaded but was thwarted.
There was a loud City cry for a penalty when Luka Vuskovic handled the ball but no infringement was the ruling; it was the same when Ndiaye’s cross seemed to be parried by Dunk’s arm.
Maresca kept his word about City (currently) being “Gio plus 10” as Donnarumma started, though there were two changes from the loss at Aston Villa as Marc Guéhi and Rayan Cherki were dropped, Matheus Nunes and Bouaddi selected.
For the second half the Italian could retain his XI as City promised they might score soon. This was if the ascendancy of the opening period continued. But Brighton dominated for a passage, as they did during the initial exchanges.
De Cuyper blasted over a fine chance before Ndiaye’s radar was better, another blazing run along the right this time ending with a blistering shot that Verbruggen tipped on to the bar.
This was end-to-end fare. Pascal Gross tipped the ball in and De Cuyper headed it, Donnarumma diving right to fend it away from goal.
On 55 minutes, Maresca brought on Cherki for Bouaddi and the Frenchman’s contribution was to thread Nunes in, but the right-back’s fierce effort was saved. Jack Hinshelwood, introduced on 72 minutes, spurned a chance, as the end of normal time neared, to double Brighton’s lead, missing with a lob.
It did not matter as they moved to 19 points, two behind City; expect both to remain high up throughout.

## ब्राइटन की ऐतिहासिक जीत

हालिया फुटबॉल मुकाबलों में ब्राइटन ने मैनचेस्टर सिटी को हराकर एक महत्वपूर्ण सफलता हासिल की है। इस मुकाबले में यासिन अयारी के शुरुआती गोल की मदद से ब्राइटन ने शानदार प्रदर्शन करते हुए जीत दर्ज की। रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, यह मैच दोनों टीमों के लिए कड़ी टक्कर वाला रहा, जिसमें ब्राइटन की टीम ने अपनी बढ़त को अंत तक सुरक्षित रखा।

## मैच के मुख्य आकर्षण और आँकड़े

मैच के दौरान निम्नलिखित मुख्य बातें सामने आईं:

* **निर्णायक गोल:** मैच के 11वें मिनट में यासिन अयारी ने ब्राइटन के लिए एकमात्र गोल किया।
* **अंक तालिका:** इस जीत के साथ ब्राइटन के अंक बढ़कर 19 हो गए हैं, और वह तालिका में शीर्ष टीमों के करीब पहुँच गई है।
* **रिकॉर्ड:** उपलब्ध जानकारी के अनुसार, ब्राइटन ने पहली बार मैनचेस्टर सिटी के खिलाफ उनके मैदान पर जीत दर्ज की है।

## मैदान पर मैदानी कार्रवाई और संघर्ष

मैनचेस्टर सिटी ने गोल करने के कई प्रयास किए और कुल 21 शॉट लिए, लेकिन टीम को सफलता नहीं मिली। एर्लिंग Haaland और इलिमान एनडिएये ने बराबरी हासिल करने के कई मौके बनाए, जिन्हें ब्राइटन के गोलकीपर बार्ट वर्ब्रूगेन और मजबूत रक्षा पंक्ति ने विफल कर दिया। रिपोर्ट में बताया गया है कि सिटी की टीम ने मैच में दबाव बनाया, लेकिन अंतिम क्षणों में फिनिशिंग की कमी के कारण उन्हें हार का सामना करना पड़ा।

## आगे की स्थिति और सत्यापन

प्रबंधक एन्जो मारेस्का के नेतृत्व में मैनचेस्टर सिटी की यह लगातार दूसरी हार है। विश्लेषकों का मानना है कि इस हार के बावजूद टीम शीर्ष स्तर पर बनी हुई है। आधिकारिक घोषणाओं और विस्तृत आँकड़ों के लिए प्रीमियर लीग की आधिकारिक वेबसाइट या संबंधित खेल पोर्टल्स की सहायता ली जा सकती है।

## Brighton Claims Historic Away Win Against City

Brighton secured a landmark victory in the Premier League, defeating Manchester City to close the gap on the league leaders. According to match reports, Yasin Ayari scored the decisive goal in the 11th minute, capitalizing on a chance following a disputed free-kick. 

The result marks Brighton's first-ever away win against Manchester City in any competition across 18 attempts, moving the club to 19 points in the standings, just two behind City. 

## Match Breakdown and Key Statistics

Despite heavy pressure and numerous attempts from the home side, Brighton's defense successfully preserved their lead. Statistical highlights from the fixture include:

* **Milestone Victory:** Brighton achieved their first away win against Manchester City in 18 attempts.
* **Defensive Form:** Brighton recorded their sixth clean sheet of the season, maintaining clean sheets in five of their last six victories.
* **City's Scoring Drought:** Manchester City failed to score at home in the Premier League for the first time in 23 games, dating back to August 2025.
* **Missed Opportunities:** City registered 21 shots during the match without finding the back of the net.

## Reported Tactical Adjustments

Manchester City dominated periods of possession and tested Brighton's goalkeeper Bart Verbruggen with multiple attacking raids, including efforts from Erling Haaland, Jérémy Doku, and Iliman Ndiaye. Manager Enzo Maresca introduced substitutes such as Phil Foden, Allan Elias, and Rayan Cherki in the second half to search for an equalizer, though Brighton's backline held firm. 

Managerial comments indicated that the officiating surrounding the buildup to the opening goal remains a point of discussion, though further reviews will determine official League assessments.

## Verification and Practical Implications

Readers seeking to verify the official match details, statistics, and league standings can consult the official Premier League website or certified sports data providers such as Opta. Official club channels for Brighton & Hove Albion and Manchester City also provide complete match summaries and post-match press conferences.
